name: Border of Rain
source:
The communist utopia without disease and aging has many dark sides. Metakarma, the subconscious operating supersystem on which the stable society of long-livers is built, has become a window into a world of horror and extraordinary psychic deviations.

At the center of the narrative is Rain, one of the five nullified, who has received a mysterious message from his past self. The main clue to the memories is an almost unbreakable Metakarma. Rain resorts to the one and most dangerous method of hacking, called unregimentation. Where will the search for truth lead? How quickly will Rain go crazy? Can he make one of the three psychopaths fall in love with him? That's up to you.

[From [url=https://fatumblack.itch.io/borderofrain]Itch.io[/url]]
